record.question: Mark wants to institute a suit to obtain urgent and immediate relief against the State Government without serving Notice u/s 80 CPC.
options: Mark upon leave being granted can institute the suit and obtain relief sought.
Mark upon leave being granted can institute the suit and obtain interim relief only.
Upon leave being granted, opportunity to show cause in respect of the relief sought by Mark must be given.
Upon leave being given, the Court if satisfied with the urgency can grant the relief to Mark suo motu.
